shortDescription: BASF XETR:BAS said on Monday it had mandated Citi, Deutsche Bank, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan as global coordinators for the planned listing of its Agricultural Solutions business.The company targets to be ready for an initial public offering of the business by mid-2027.
